notes: Descriptive outbreak report with no models or tests; CFR, percentages and population comparisons are arithmetic or side-by-side, so procedures is empty and scale is null. Prepass cues for diagnostic accuracy (lab sensitivity) are false hits and 'quantile' is a table label only. Social vulnerability scores are attached to case residence tracts and are treated as descriptors, not as a separate data source.
